lines.text: # Producer tokens: what the experiments showed

Steps fell from 21 to 14 between 0.8.0 and `main`, and producer tokens stayed near 2.7M. These runs ask why, and what is worth changing. Producer only (`composer-2.5`, graders off). A step is one assistant message. Tool calls are counted separately. Tokens are `usage.totalTokens` (input + cache read + output).

Issue [#94](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/issues/94) makes a hunk ref a path, or `path@oldStart+newStart` when a file is split. That shrinks the JSON the agent writes. It does not shrink the diff the agent reads. The diff is the large object. The JSON is not.
## Where the bytes are
Static counts, `o200k_base`, the 7 eval cases. One copy of each artifact, before any re-send.
| | Tokens |
| `references/example.md` | 1,032 |
| Covering diff, `-U3`, all 7 cases | 81,049 |
| Hunk headers only (`diff --git` and `@@`) | 7,678 |
| Skeleton, one object per hunk | 18,855 |
| Skeleton, one path per file | 1,787 |
The largest diff is comprehende-47: 29,912 tokens, 173 hunks, 38 files. Its object skeleton is 8,560 tokens. File paths are 503.

Suite producer output on the `main` eval was 42,141 tokens, about 1.5% of 2.65M. A 40% cut in written refs, which is the [#94](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/issues/94) measurement in [token-efficiency.md](./token-efficiency.md), is on the order of 10k output tokens. Re-sending an 8.5k skeleton a few times is still small next to a 600k case.

`main`'s eval run did 14 assistant messages and 106 tool calls. Each tool result stays in the conversation and is sent again on the next call. That is why fewer assistant messages did not move the token total.
## Three procedures, same cases
Each cell is one producer run today, then `validate` and the case's deterministic expects. All of them passed those checks. Prose lint is advisory and does not fail the run.
| Case | Baseline skill | Plan file, script copies refs | Headers only, no full diff |
| comprehende-50 (5 hunks, 1.6k diff) | 178,359 · 12 tools | 180,735 · 12 tools | 195,680 · 12 tools |
| comprehende-47 (173 hunks, 30k diff) | 607,108 · 22 tools | 652,686 · 21 tools | 286,437 · 15 tools, then 729,557 · 24 tools |
| comprehende-59 (63 hunks, 10k diff without the lockfile) | 299,851 · 13 tools | | 348,483 · 20 tools |

The plan variant keeps the full diff. The agent writes `plan.json` (prose and file paths). `expand-plan.mjs` copies hunk objects out of the skeleton. That is [#94](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/issues/94) as a script, without a schema change. On both cases the agent still loaded the full diff, and tokens did not fall.
The headers variant replaces the covering `git diff` with `git diff -U0 | grep` of headers. The agent may open a file when a header is too thin for the summary.

comprehende-47, first headers run: the full diff never entered context. The agent read two UI files, copied hunks with a node script once, and finished at 286k. Summaries name `parse.ts`, `pins.ts`, `SourceCite`, and the comments toggle. `apart` passed.

comprehende-47, second headers run: still no full diff. The agent re-ran `review`, read source files, and rewrote a hunk-copy script three times after `validate` failed. 730k. The review that came out is the same shape as the cheap run: typed `sources`, citation UI, Pierre pins. The extra tokens are the retry, not a richer diff.

comprehende-59 headers: no full diff, then seven source-file reads. 348k against a 300k baseline that read the lockfile-excluded diff once. Summaries still name `useNarrow`, `MobileShell`, and `ReviewStage`.
comprehende-50 is already a 1.6k diff. Headers added a tool and the tokens went up.
## What to change
Do not ship headers-only. The two comprehende-47 runs used the same header command. One finished at 286k, the next at 730k. The mid-size case spent the missing diff on whole-file reads and cost more.

Do measure [#94](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/issues/94) on comprehende-47, twice, before treating it as a token win. The static JSON saving is too small to move a 600k case. The thing it removes is the hunk-copy script. That script showed up in the baseline and in both headers runs. The run that retried it cost more than the run that loaded the 30k diff. File refs make the script unnecessary, so the tail should shrink. The median moves only if that tail was the common path. One successful script (the 607k baseline) and one retried script (the 730k headers run) are not enough to price it. The schema change is the experiment, not another paragraph in the skill: the plan-file paragraph did not stop the agent from loading the diff.

Leave the covering diff in the skill until that measurement exists. The diff of all 7 cases is 81k tokens once. It dominates only when a spilled file is read again, or when a retry keeps the conversation. A skill sentence did not make that reliable.
